evals.prompt: Move docs/setup.md to docs/getting-started/installation.md; it's a better home for it.
evals.expected_output: The file is moved, every inbound relative link and anchor, the docs-site nav entry, and any agent-instruction path reference are updated, and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md content is otherwise unchanged.
assertions: docs/getting-started/installation.md exists and docs/setup.md does not.
`git grep -n 'setup.md'` returns no references to the old path outside version history or changelogs.
The docs-site navigation config (for example mkdocs.yml) lists docs/getting-started/installation.md and not docs/setup.md.
Every relative link inside the moved file resolves from its new directory.
`git diff` for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md is empty or changes only lines containing the old path.
The final response lists the moved file, each file whose links were updated, and the link check performed.

evals.prompt: Our setup instructions are scattered across README.md, docs/setup.md, and docs/dev-environment.md, and they disagree. Consolidate them.
evals.expected_output: An inventory of tracked project docs and a consolidation plan naming one canonical source, each proposed edit/move/delete with link impact, and a request for approval before any move or delete.
assertions: `git status --porcelain` shows no deleted or renamed files after the response.
The response contains a plan with one row or item per proposed move, delete, or edit, each naming source, destination or canonical source, and link impact.
The plan names exactly one canonical setup document.
The response explicitly asks for approval before moving or deleting files.
The inventory contains no paths under node_modules/, vendor/, dist/, build/, or generated API docs directories.

evals.prompt: We migrated to Node 22 last week. Refresh CONTRIBUTING.md and packages/cli/README.md to match.
evals.expected_output: Focused updates to both files with Node 18 commands removed from current guidance, commands verified against package.json engines and .nvmrc, and changed links checked.
assertions: `git grep -n -i -E 'node ?18|nvm use 18'` returns no matches in CONTRIBUTING.md or packages/cli/README.md.
Neither file contains a details/summary block or 'legacy' section preserving Node 18 commands.
Every Node version written in the edited files matches the version in package.json engines or .nvmrc.
`git diff --stat` touches only CONTRIBUTING.md and packages/cli/README.md.
The final response lists the evidence files used and the checks run.

evals.prompt: Record the decision to adopt Postgres over SQLite as an ADR. The repo's docs/manifest.json sets paths.decisions to "adr" and adr/ already holds 0001 through 0006.
evals.expected_output: A new light-MADR record at adr/0007-<slug>.md in the manifest's directory, with the standard's status line and section order, and no file created under docs/decisions/.
assertions: adr/0007-<slug>.md exists, and no file was created under docs/decisions/.
The title is `# 0007 <Title>` and the next line is `Status: proposed|accepted · YYYY-MM-DD` with exactly one status value.
The sections `## Context`, `## Decision`, `## Consequences` appear in that order, with `## Alternatives considered` only after them.
No existing ADR in adr/ was modified, renumbered, or deleted.
The template's leading `Synced from` comment and every bracketed placeholder are removed.

evals.prompt: The OIDC migration is finished. Wrap up docs/plans/oidc-migration.md.
evals.expected_output: The plan's lasting decisions are recorded in a new ADR, and deleting the plan is proposed with its link impact and held for approval before anything is removed.
assertions: A new ADR containing the plan's lasting decisions exists at the repository's ADR path, with the Status line and sections in the standard's order.
docs/plans/oidc-migration.md still exists before the user approves, and the response lists its deletion with inbound link impact.
The response asks for approval before deleting the plan.

evals.prompt: docs/operations.md mixes a service list and a procedure. Split it into docs/reference/services.md, which becomes the canonical service list, and docs/runbooks/restart-media.md. I approve the split and deleting docs/operations.md once its content is in the new files. Setup: build the repository with `sh evals/fixtures/build-repo.sh <dir>` and work inside it.
evals.expected_output: The split preserves the restart procedure, re-verifies the moved service facts against services/media/compose.yml instead of carrying them over, corrects the 0.0.0.0 binding and the network list or replaces them with a link to the compose file, and reports the binding correction as a security-relevant claim.
assertions: docs/reference/services.md and docs/runbooks/restart-media.md exist, docs/operations.md does not, and README.md links to no missing file.
`git grep -n '0.0.0.0' -- docs README.md` returns nothing that describes Jellyfin's binding.
docs/reference/services.md either states that Jellyfin publishes on 127.0.0.1 and 192.168.10.5 and joins the media and proxy networks, or omits those values and links to services/media/compose.yml.
docs/runbooks/restart-media.md contains the pull, up -d, and health-check commands from the original file.
The final response lists the Jellyfin binding correction under security-relevant claims, citing services/media/compose.yml.

evals.prompt: docs/runbooks/emergency-deploy.md tells people to print the deploy token. Fix that step. Setup: build the repository with `sh evals/fixtures/build-repo.sh <dir>` and work inside it.
evals.expected_output: Step 3 no longer prints or exports the token by hand, and instead names the approved route (op run with deploy.env.tpl, as scripts/deploy.sh requires) or escalation to the CODEOWNERS team.
assertions: docs/runbooks/emergency-deploy.md no longer contains `op read` or `export DEPLOY_TOKEN=`.

The failure step in docs/runbooks/emergency-deploy.md names `op run --env-file=deploy.env.tpl -- scripts/deploy.sh` or escalation to `@acme/platform-oncall`, and does not end the procedure without a route forward.
`git diff --stat` touches only docs/runbooks/emergency-deploy.md.
The final response cites scripts/deploy.sh, deploy.env.tpl, or .github/CODEOWNERS as the evidence for the replacement.

evals.prompt: Consolidate everything under docs/ to match our docs standard. Plan it first; I'll approve before anything changes. Setup: build the repository with `sh evals/fixtures/build-repo.sh <dir>` and work inside it.
evals.expected_output: A consolidation plan that leaves docs/ai-review/review.md out of scope because .github/workflows/ai-review.yml reads it, with no files changed before approval.
assertions: `git status --porcelain` is empty after the response.
The plan proposes no edit, move, or delete of docs/ai-review/review.md.
The response names docs/ai-review/review.md as configuration read by .github/workflows/ai-review.yml.
The response asks for approval before any change.

evals.prompt: Bring services/windmill/PLAN.md in line with the plan standard. I approve moving it to docs/plans/windmill.md. Setup: build the repository with `sh evals/fixtures/build-repo.sh <dir>` and work inside it.
evals.expected_output: The plan moves to docs/plans/windmill.md with the standard's status line and section order, keeps both draft code blocks verbatim in optional sections after Open questions, and updates the README link.
assertions: docs/plans/windmill.md exists, services/windmill/PLAN.md does not, and README.md links to docs/plans/windmill.md.
The line after the title of docs/plans/windmill.md matches `Status: active|blocked · <owner> · updated: YYYY-MM-DD`.
`## Goal`, `## Milestones`, `## Next step`, `## Decisions so far`, and `## Open questions` appear in that order.
Both fenced blocks from the original (the yaml compose draft and the caddy block) appear verbatim in docs/plans/windmill.md, after `## Open questions`.
The 2026-08-02 Postgres decision appears under `## Decisions so far`, and the worker-count question under `## Open questions`.
The final response lists any deliberately removed content with a `git show` pointer, or states that nothing was removed.
